grounding.states: Honda Odyssey ranks #1 among minivans in the U.S. News rankings, with an overall score of 9.3 out of 10
grounding.from: U.S. News ranks the 2026 Honda Odyssey #1. It gives the Odyssey an overall score of 9.3 out of 10.

grounding.states: Kelley Blue Book also ranks the Honda Odyssey #1 in minivans
grounding.from: Kelley Blue Book (about 187 days old) ranks the 2026 Honda Odyssey #1 in minivans.

grounding.states: Edmunds calls the Odyssey the minivan it most likes driving
grounding.from: Edmunds calls the Odyssey the minivan it most likes driving, and the best non-hybrid.

grounding.states: Toyota Sienna gets 36 mpg combined and is offered only as a hybrid
grounding.from: The Sienna gets 36 mpg combined in front-wheel drive. It's the only minivan offered only as a hybrid.

grounding.states: The rankings disagree on a single best minivan, and these results cover the U.S. market only
grounding.from: No single "best." The major rankings pick different winners. The results are all U.S. market, so these notes cover the U.S. only.

value.answer: In the U.S., I'd go with the Honda Odyssey. U.S. News has it first with a 9.3 out of 10, Kelley Blue Book ranks it #1 too, and Edmunds says it's the minivan they most like to drive. If fuel economy matters most, get the Toyota Sienna: it's hybrid only and gets 36 mpg combined. The rankings don't agree on one winner, so this is my pick, not a consensus.
